name: AutoResponder
short: Bot-global automatic replies triggered by words or phrases in any server.
description: Bot owners manage a single global list of word/phrase triggers and responses. Fatboy automatically replies whenever a human uses a matching trigger in any server the bot has joined, including text threads. Includes a one-time migration of previous per-server rules, whole-word matching, no-mention replies, independent channel cooldowns, and globally persistent settings.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Stores one bot-global list of owner-configured trigger strings and responses, global enabled/cooldown settings, and a one-time legacy migration flag. Prior guild-scoped rules are merged on the first upgrade and retained as an unmodified backup. No Discord user IDs or message history are saved; transient channel cooldown records reside only in memory.
install_msg: AutoResponder installed. Load with [p]load autoresponder. Bot owners configure one global response shared across all guilds using [p]ar add hello | Hey there! Enable Message Content Intent.
